234352.note: The pin is on the cabin at the meadow's edge, and the drawn road passes 10 m south of it.

234353.note: The Forest Service's point, 185 m north of the pin, is on a forested slope just above an undrawn graded road the photo and ground relief both show, with no building or pad.
